title: Vanishing gap at the sharp moment bound
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $P$ be a probability law on $\Omega$, let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$, and let $r,l$ be nonnegative integers with $r>0$ and $l\le r$. If $\mathbb E_P[X^{2l}]=(2r-1)^l\binom rl/\binom{2r}{2l}$, then $\binom{2r}{2l}(2r-1)^{-l}\mathbb E_P[X^{2l}]-\binom rl=0$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
